upstream_related_work.title: K8SPSMDB-1211: handle FULL CLUSTER CRASH error during the restore
upstream_related_work.relevance: The author describes physical restore erroneously triggering FULL CLUSTER CRASH recovery and proposes retaining the restore-in-progress annotation while handling recovery after StatefulSet recreation. The pinned 1.23.1 reconcileCluster checks only the StatefulSet annotation before its ReplicaSetNoPrimary recovery, which force-reconfigures the first ready member. This supports investigation of the controller timing; it does not establish the complete cause of this run or provide a released fix.
